t: This is King Edward VII's Hospital, a private hospital on Beaumont Street in Marylebone. It carries the name of the king who reigned from 1901 until his death in 1910, and also of Agnes Keyser, a wealthy philanthropist and longtime companion of the king, who stayed with him until he died. Several well-known people died here. Princess Margaret, the Queen's only sister, is one. Another is Enoch Powell, the politician who was Minister of Health in the early 1960s. The jazz saxophonist and bandleader John Dankworth died here too, as did air marshal Geoffrey Salmond.
